services.name: Preschool Programs
services.desc: World’s preschool program helps young athletes from ages 18ths to 5yrs, with their hand eye coordination, gross motor skills, & social skills. Preschool classes teach little ones to listen & following directions.Our preschoolers will gain confidence & build the beginning foundations of gymnastics & tumbling by using preschool sized equipment with World’s trained preschool instructors. PARENT & TOT: 18 TO 36 MONTHS FOR 45 MINTINYROO: 30 TO 36 MONTHS FOR 30 MINGYMAROO: 3 TO 5 YRS FOR 45
